cards.title: git status
cards.body: `git status` tells you what Git sees: untracked files (new to Git), changes, and what is staged.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git status

hi.title: git status
hi.body: `git status` batata hai Git kya dekh raha hai: untracked files (Git ke liye nayi), changes, aur kya staged hai.

cards.title: Staging with git add
cards.body: `git add <file>` puts a file in the staging area, the list of changes for your next commit. `git add .` stages everything.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html notes.txt
git add index.html
git status

hi.title: git add se staging
hi.body: `git add <file>` file ko staging area mein daalta hai, yaani agle commit ke changes ki list. `git add .` sab kuch stage kar deta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: `git status` still shows the file as not staged. Tap the bug.
cards.code:
git init
touch notes.txt
git add notes
git status

bug.fix: The file is called `notes.txt`, and `git add` needs its full name: `git add notes.txt`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: `git status` abhi bhi file ko not staged dikhata hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: File ka naam `notes.txt` hai, aur `git add` ko poora naam chahiye: `git add notes.txt`.

check.question: After `git add index.html`, where is index.html?
options: In the staging area, ready to commit
check.explanation: Staging only marks it for the next commit. Nothing is saved or uploaded yet.

hi.question: `git add index.html` ke baad index.html kahan hai?
options: Staging area mein, commit ke liye ready
hi.explanation: Staging sirf use agle commit ke liye mark karta hai. Abhi kuch save ya upload nahi hua.

exercise.prompt: This repository has two new files. Stage only `index.html`, and leave `notes.txt` unstaged.
exercise.promptHi: Is repository mein do nayi files hain. Sirf `index.html` ko stage karo, aur `notes.txt` ko unstaged chhodo.
